headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth, led by TCS and HCLTech, while AI initiatives gained traction.
summary: Revenue rose across the sector, with TCS reporting ₹73,188 cr and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech delivered 3% QoQ revenue growth and highlighted AI sales as a key driver. Tech Mahindra and Wipro posted double‑digit YoY revenue growth, but profit momentum was mixed. Several peers (Infosys, LTM, OFSS) have not released results, limiting a full view.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Companies such as TCS, HCLTech and Wipro emphasized AI revenue contributions and strategic investments.

themes.title: Margin pressure at mid‑tier players
themes.detail: Mid‑size firms reported operating margins below 20%, indicating cost pressures despite revenue gains.
